headline: OpenAI is letting ChatGPT answer questions with interactive charts, diagrams and buttons.
score_reason: Pool 9, kept: a major change to a widely used assistant, rolling out from 7 Oct 2026.
importance_line: It changes what everyday ChatGPT users see when they ask a question, but the quality and safety claims come from OpenAI's own announcement and no outside test is reported yet.
summary: The Verge reports that OpenAI is rolling out an Intelligent UI feature in ChatGPT, so answers can mix text with diagrams, charts, forms and tappable buttons. The feature comes with GPT-6, OpenAI's newest model family, and reaches paying Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users from 7 Oct 2026, with the free and Go plans following on Thursday, 8 Oct.
notes: Full article read. The article says the GPT-6 family was announced last month; this entry covers the feature rollout.
